text: About the middle of the 19th century, a new church was built at Mosfell. A few decades later, however, the Mosfell church was demolished and a new church was built at Lagafell. Bitter conflicts ensued and many people in the county of Mosfell protested the demolition of the Mosfell church. The bell and chalice of the church unexplainably disappeared and only later did the bell and chalice reappear at Hrísbrú where the inhabitants had preserved them for 80 years.
